stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract
stories.description: Define canonical audit log schema including event_id, timestamp, actor (GPT/Claude/system), action, input_hash, output_hash, metadata, and immutable append-only constraints. Establish storage contract enforcing no updates/deletes.

stories.title: Append-Only Audit Logging Core Service
stories.description: Implement backend service to write audit events in append-only mode with hash chaining or write-once guarantees. Ensure all GPT and Claude operations emit structured audit events.

stories.title: Audit Logging Integration with Tooling and Agents
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into GPTReader, tool_router, Brain runner, and safety services to capture all tool invocations, decisions, and safety-triggered events.

stories.title: Audit Log Access API (Read-Only)
stories.description: Expose secure, read-only API endpoints for querying audit logs with filtering (time range, actor, action). Enforce strict access control and prevent mutation operations.

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Integrity Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only behavior, event completeness, tamper resistance (no updates/deletes), and coverage across GPT/Claude workflows.
